svg.title: C# Modifiers Overview
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing all categories of C# modifiers: access, inheritance, member behavior, and type modifiers.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain all access modifiers in C#')
sendPrompt('Explain inheritance modifiers in C# like abstract virtual override sealed')
sendPrompt('Explain static readonly const volatile modifiers in C#')
sendPrompt('Explain partial unsafe extern modifiers in C#')

g.text: A modifier is a keyword placed before a type or member declaration
e.g. public static readonly string Name = "Claude";

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does static mean in C#?')
sendPrompt('What does readonly mean in C#?')
sendPrompt('What are value types vs reference types in C#?')
sendPrompt('How do you name variables in C#?')
